title: Annuitizing a Fixed Indexed Annuities Contract into an Ashgrove Income Annuity
content:
**Training notes — annuitization of Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities**

**Provision.** The owner may apply the contract value to an Ashgrove income annuity. Annuitization is processed only on an annuitization election signed by the owner and approved, except at the maturity date. From the tier's first charge-free annuitization contract year, annuitization is free of surrender charge and bonus recapture when the income option has a life contingency or a period certain of at least the tier's shortest period certain. At the maturity age the contract is annuitized on a life with 10-year period certain basis unless the owner elects otherwise before that date. A contract in income phase cannot be annuitized; its lifetime withdrawals continue instead.

The election is read from Ashgrove's service request record for that election — its request type, signed date and approved request status — before the annuitization is processed.

### Questions the provision answers

**What does annuitization buy?** An Ashgrove income annuity, bought with the contract value applied to it.

**Is a signed, approved election always needed?** Yes, except at the maturity date, when the contract is annuitized without one.

**What income options are free of surrender charge and bonus recapture?** From the first charge-free annuitization contract year (contract year 2 on every tier): an option with a life contingency, or an option with a period certain of at least 5 years.

**What happens at the maturity age of 95?** The contract is annuitized on a life with 10-year period certain basis, unless the owner elected otherwise before that date.

**Can a contract in income phase be annuitized?** No. Its lifetime withdrawals continue instead.

### Hypothetical cases

| Case | Facts | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Active contract, contract year 3, signed and approved election, life with 10-year period certain | Processed; free of surrender charge and bonus recapture (life contingency) |
| 2 | Active contract, contract year 4, signed and approved election, 7-year period certain with no life contingency | Processed; free of surrender charge and bonus recapture (period certain of at least 5 years) |
| 3 | Active contract, contract year 2, election signed but its request status not approved | Not processed (outside the maturity date) |
| 4 | Contract in income phase, signed and approved election | Cannot be annuitized; lifetime withdrawals continue |
| 5 | Annuitant reaches 95; owner made no other election before that date | Annuitized on a life with 10-year period certain basis |
